title: bidens polylepis f. retrorsa
intro: Bidens polylepis f. retrorsa, commonly known as the Himalayan tickseed, is a flowering plant species in the aster family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Bidens polylepis f. retrorsa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit antispasmodic and sedative properties.
